title: Hilton Accelerates Lifestyle Growth in South East Asia with First Tempo by Hilton Signing in Phuket
summary: Located in Bang Tao, the hotel will place guests close to Phuket’s beaches, dining, wellness and lifestyle attractions.

Listen to this article


0:00


- **164-room hotel will mark debut of Hilton’s contemporary lifestyle brand in South East Asia and one of Tempo by Hilton’s first resort destinations globally.**
- **Expected to open in the fourth quarter of 2030, Tempo by Hilton Phuket Bang Tao will feature thoughtfully designed rooms, balanced food and beverage offerings, amenities centered on mindful living and inviting social spaces that support both productivity and relaxation.**
- **Located in Bang Tao, the hotel will place guests close to Phuket’s beaches, dining, wellness and lifestyle attractions, 19 kilometers away from Phuket International Airport.**


**PHUKET, Thailand** –[Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/?_gl=1*1fra2ae*_gcl_aw*R0NMLjE3Mzk5NzE1OTAuQ2p3S0NBaUFuOWE5QmhCdEVpd0FiS2c2ZmtjQnRpYzd6aTltdGlDZTdFdC00YmtFVnE3STFuVnZTemRkNmVMWlFFcFF3cUdsYThEZUJSb0NRUXdRQXZEX0J3RQ..*_gcl_dc*R0NMLjE3Mzk5NzE1OTAuQ2p3S0NBaUFuOWE5QmhCdEVpd0FiS2c2ZmtjQnRpYzd6aTltdGlDZTdFdC00YmtFVnE3STFuVnZTemRkNmVMWlFFcFF3cUdsYThEZUJSb0NRUXdRQXZEX0J3RQ..*_gcl_au*MTY5NjYxODEuMTc0MDAzMjc0MA..) (NYSE: HLT) today announced the signing of Tempo by Hilton Phuket Bang Tao, the first under the brand in South East Asia, in partnership with Sindhu Development Co., Ltd. Expected to open in 2030, the hotel will bring Tempo’s vibrant, contemporary approach to hospitality to Phuket, offering a thoughtfully designed stay for today’s modern traveler.


Set in the southern stretch of Bang Tao, one of Phuket’s longest beaches, the new-build hotel will offer a relaxed destination for travelers to explore the island’s beaches, dining, wellness and lifestyle scene. Nearby attractions include lifestyle shopping and dining destinations such as Porto de Phuket and Boat Avenue, beach clubs and golf courses. The hotel will be 19 kilometers from Phuket International Airport.


[Tempo by Hilton](https://stories.hilton.com/brands/tempo-by-hilton) is a stylish, contemporary lifestyle brand designed for ambitious travelers looking to maintain a sense of balance and momentum wherever their travels take them. The brand brings together purposefully designed guest rooms, buzzy and inviting public spaces, amenities centered on mindful living and balanced food and beverage offerings, helping guests find their own rhythm, power up for the day and power down with ease. Launched in 2020, Tempo by Hilton was created to fill portfolio white space for a growing segment of “modern achievers” who seek a hotel experience that fits seamlessly into their lifestyle and routines and supports their wellbeing. For owners, Tempo offers a scalable brand with strong commercial potential. Hilton currently has 10 trading Tempo hotels and more than 80 under development around the world, demonstrating its strong appeal for guests and owners. The[first Tempo by Hilton hotel](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/first-tempo-by-hilton-debuts-times-square) debuted in Times Square, New York, in 2023 and recently confirmed plans to debut in Europe and the UK, with its first projects in Germany and Northern Ireland. The Phuket signing builds on Tempo’s growing momentum in Asia Pacific, following the[brand’s first signings in China](https://stories.hilton.com/apac/releases/tempo-by-hilton-to-debut-in-asia-pacific-first-signings-in-china) across key destinations including Xiamen, Beijing, Chengdu and Jiaxing.


“Phuket is one of Asia’s most established resort destinations, and Bang Tao’s growing mix of beaches, wellness, dining and lifestyle experiences makes it a compelling setting for Tempo by Hilton’s South East Asia debut,” said Maria Ariizumi, vice president, Development, South East Asia, Hilton. “This signing reflects our continued focus on bringing the right brands to high-growth destinations in partnership with owners. Tempo by Hilton Phuket Bang Tao will introduce a lifestyle experience built around balance and momentum, adding a differentiated offering to our Phuket portfolio for travelers who want to stay connected to their social rhythm while enjoying the best of the destination.”


Designed as a low-rise resort, the hotel will feature **164 guest rooms** , including family rooms and suites. The hotel will feature an all-day dining restaurant, two bars, a gym and an outdoor swimming pool. Further details on the hotel’s design and guest offerings will be shared closer to opening.


“As Phuket evolves as a world-class lifestyle destination, we believe great hospitality goes beyond providing a place to stay. Our vision is to create thoughtfully designed spaces and meaningful experiences that reflect the way people travel today. Partnering with Hilton to introduce the first Tempo by Hilton in South East Asia marks a significant milestone for us. Together, we look forward to bringing a fresh perspective to Phuket’s hospitality landscape and creating a destination that guests will look forward to discovering and returning to,” said Naphatsawan Kanchanamethakul, managing director, Sindhu Development Co., Ltd.


The signing strengthens Hilton’s lifestyle growth in Asia Pacific with more than 200 trading luxury and lifestyle hotels in the region and 85 under development, putting the company on track to exceed its[previously stated target of 250 luxury and lifestyle properties](https://stories.hilton.com/apac/releases/hilton-to-exceed-250-luxury-and-lifestyle-hotels-in-asia-pacific) . The property joins 34 trading hotels in Thailand, where Hilton has another 15 under development. In Phuket, DoubleTree by Hilton Phuket Banthai Resort currently welcomes guests and the company’s growing pipeline includes Andamanda Voyage Phuket, Curio Collection by Hilton; The Rawai Phuket, LXR Hotels & Resorts and Mamaka Phuket, Tapestry Collection by Hilton. Tempo by Hilton Phuket Bang Tao is also expected to be among the brand’s first hotels in a resort destination globally.


Tempo by Hilton Phuket Bang Tao will participate in[Hilton Honors](https://www.hilton.com/en/hilton-honors-rewards-program/) , the award-winning guest loyalty programme for Hilton’s 28 distinct hotel brands. Hilton Honors members who book directly through preferred Hilton channels have access to instant benefits, including member discounts, free standard Wi-Fi and the Hilton Honors mobile app.


##### FAQ: Hilton Signs First Tempo by Hilton in South East Asia in Phuket


Tempo by Hilton Phuket Bang Tao is a 164-room new-build hotel planned for Bang Tao, Phuket. Expected to open in the fourth quarter of 2030, the hotel will mark the debut of Tempo by Hilton in South East Asia.


Tempo by Hilton Phuket Bang Tao will be located in the southern stretch of Bang Tao, one of Phuket’s longest beaches. The hotel will be close to Porto de Phuket, Boat Avenue, beach clubs and golf courses, with Phuket International Airport approximately 19 kilometers away.


Tempo by Hilton Phuket Bang Tao is expected to open in the fourth quarter of 2030.


Tempo by Hilton Phuket Bang Tao is planned to feature 164 guest rooms, including family rooms and suites, as well as an all-day dining restaurant, two bars, a fitness center and an outdoor swimming pool.


Tempo by Hilton Phuket Bang Tao will mark the first Tempo by Hilton in South East Asia and is expected to be among the brand’s first resort destinations globally. The signing also expands Hilton’s presence in Phuket and strengthens its lifestyle growth in Asia Pacific.
